newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares mostly flat, consolidating.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares mostly flat, consolidating.

text.p: Norwegian shares traded sideways on Tuesday as the Oslo Stock Exchange consolidated with most of Europe following heavy gains on Monday, dealers said.
Oslo's Total index rose 0.13 percent to 1,064.74 points in moderate turnover of 997 million crowns.
It followed a 2.75 percent rise on Monday when Oslo gained impetus from overseas markets and was lifted by a rebound in offshore and technology stocks.
"Many clients think the upturn was fragile," one dealer said. "It is hard to find buyers. Today was pretty boring."

"The market will be slow in the next month," another dealer predicted. "We will be trading sideways. I don't believe in a correction downwards but not in a rise either given the uncertainty about U.S. interest rates."
Norsk Hydro was the most traded share at 108 million crowns, rising 0.61 percent to 330 crowns.
